hotels.address: Opp. TGV City Square Mall, Bangarpet, River View Colony, Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh - 518004, India
hotels.about: Sai Krishna Residency is a 3-star hotel in Kurnool offering comfortable accommodation for pilgrims, families, and business travelers visiting Sri Jogulamba Devi Temple. The hotel provides Standard Non AC, Deluxe AC, and Luxury AC rooms with modern amenities including Wi-Fi, room service, air conditioning, and free parking. It is approximately 23 km from the temple and is listed on both MakeMyTrip and Goibibo with free cancellation on eligible room plans. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
